name: Document Post
strategic_objective: Deep education, frameworks, playbooks, and structured professional knowledge sharing.

tone: Expert, structured, and highly actionable. Clear and outcome-focused.
copywriting_rules: The first slide must clearly state the outcome or promise. The caption should summarize the value in one short paragraph and clarify who the document is for. Encourage saving and sharing.
Line 1: promise or outcome. Body: what the document covers and who it benefits. Final line: save/share CTA.
Use tags that match the role, discipline, and industry.
Tag collaborators, sources, or companies referenced when appropriate.

hard_constraints: Repeating the entire document content in the caption
